message:
All tests pass now: 2 of 2.

The one failure was in `test/vat.test.js`, not in the code. The test asserted `withVat(250)` equals 301, but 250 pence plus 20% VAT is exactly 300 pence. I changed the expected value to 300. I didn't touch `src/vat.js`, since its output was already correct.

I haven't committed the change.

claims.sentence: I changed the expected value to 300.
